system.description:
Wall-defence tradition, volleys and coordinated fire.

  • Volley Timing: Your first bow attack each round has Advantage against a creature an ally hit with a ranged attack since your last turn.
  • Sentry's Patience: Advantage on Perception checks made during watch or sentry duty.
